quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Although the new principal cut the school's art budget in half, she doubled funding for the debate team, which had placed in the regional finals for three years running. Several art teachers have since left for other schools.
options: The funding choices coincided with a loss of art teachers.
The principal increased funding for the art program.
Every teacher at the school resigned this year.
The debate team lost its funding this year.
quests.correctAnswer: The funding choices coincided with a loss of art teachers.
quests.hint: Notice which program lost money and what happened to its staff afterward.
quests.explanation: After the art budget was cut, several art teachers left the school. The timing suggests the funding cut is connected to their departure.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: A popular messaging app recently limited free users to twenty messages a day, while keeping unlimited messaging for paying subscribers. Within a month, the number of people upgrading to a paid account had grown by nearly forty percent.
options: Paid subscriptions dropped after the change.
The message limit persuaded more free users to start paying.
The app removed its paid subscription option entirely.
The message limit had no effect on how many people paid.
quests.correctAnswer: The message limit persuaded more free users to start paying.
quests.hint: Think about what a daily message limit might push free users to do.
quests.explanation: Paid upgrades rose sharply right after the free message limit was introduced, suggesting the limit encouraged users to subscribe.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The neighborhood used to have almost no public events, and residents rarely spoke to one another outside their own homes. Since the community center began hosting a monthly potluck dinner, several neighbors have started organizing their own weekend gatherings as well.
options: Neighbors have become less friendly since the potlucks began.
The community center stopped hosting any events.
Weekend gatherings have always been common in the neighborhood.
Fewer public events used to mean less contact between neighbors.
quests.correctAnswer: Fewer public events used to mean less contact between neighbors.
quests.hint: Compare how neighbors interacted before and after the potluck dinners started.
quests.explanation: Neighbors began organizing their own gatherings only after the potluck dinners started, suggesting the events helped bring the community closer together.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Since the company allowed employees to choose their own start times between 7 and 10 a.m. each morning, the human resources department has noticed a noticeable drop in the number of sick days employees are requesting.
options: Employees seem to be taking fewer sick days under the flexible schedule.
Sick days increased after flexible start times began.
The company removed flexible scheduling this year.
Start times have no connection to how often employees are sick.
quests.correctAnswer: Employees seem to be taking fewer sick days under the flexible schedule.
quests.hint: Think about how having flexible hours might affect how employees feel.
quests.explanation: Sick day requests dropped after employees gained control over their start times, suggesting the flexibility may have improved how they feel at work.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The seafood market used to throw away large amounts of unsold fish at closing time. After starting a discount hour in the final sixty minutes, the amount thrown away each week has fallen by nearly seventy percent.
options: Far less fish is being wasted since the discount hour began.
Food waste at the market has increased since the discount hour began.
The market stopped selling fish completely.
Discount pricing never affects how much food is wasted.
quests.correctAnswer: Far less fish is being wasted since the discount hour began.
quests.hint: Compare the amount of wasted fish before and after the discount hour started.
quests.explanation: Wasted fish dropped by nearly seventy percent after the discount hour began, showing the strategy is helping the market sell fish that would otherwise go unsold.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: City workers replaced the streetlights downtown with a new energy-efficient type last year. Although the lights cost more to install, the city's electricity bill for street lighting has been cut nearly in half.
options: The new streetlights have increased the city's electricity costs.
The city removed the new streetlights due to their cost.
Streetlight type has no effect on electricity bills.
The new streetlights are saving money despite their higher installation cost.
quests.correctAnswer: The new streetlights are saving money despite their higher installation cost.
quests.hint: Compare the installation cost with what happened to the electricity bill afterward.
quests.explanation: Even though installation was more expensive, the electricity bill dropped by almost half, showing the new lights are saving money over time.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Since her parents started a weekly family game night with no phones allowed at the table, sixteen-year-old Zoe has told her friends that dinner conversations at home now feel far more relaxed than they used to be.
options: Family conversations became more tense since the game nights began.
Zoe's family stopped eating dinner together.
Removing phones during family time always ruins the mood.
The phone-free game nights seem to have improved family conversation.
quests.correctAnswer: The phone-free game nights seem to have improved family conversation.
quests.hint: Think about what removing phones during family time might change.
quests.explanation: Zoe noticed dinner conversations improved after her family started phone-free game nights, suggesting the change helped everyone communicate more easily.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The furniture store used to offer only in-store pickup, and many customers complained about needing a truck to bring items home. Since adding a home delivery option last month, online orders have increased by almost sixty percent.
options: Online orders dropped after delivery was added.
The furniture store removed its delivery option due to low interest.
Delivery options never affect how people choose to shop.
Customers are placing far more online orders than before delivery was added.
quests.correctAnswer: Customers are placing far more online orders than before delivery was added.
quests.hint: Think about what problem customers had before, and what changed.
quests.explanation: Online orders rose sharply once home delivery became available, suggesting the new option solved the inconvenience customers had complained about.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Employees at the accounting firm used to eat lunch at their desks almost every day. Since the company began offering a free thirty-minute walking group at noon, several employees say they feel noticeably less stressed by the end of the workday.
options: Employees feel more stressed since the walking group started.
The company cancelled the walking group after low interest.
Taking a midday walk never affects a person's stress levels.
Joining the walking group seems to be easing employees' stress.
quests.correctAnswer: Joining the walking group seems to be easing employees' stress.
quests.hint: Compare how employees felt before and after the walking group started.
quests.explanation: Employees report feeling less stressed since the walking group began, suggesting the daily activity is helping them manage work-related stress.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The budget airline used to charge a separate fee for every checked bag, which frustrated many travelers. After switching to one flat fee that includes a bag, customer satisfaction ratings for the airline have risen for three straight quarters.
options: Customer satisfaction fell after the pricing change.
The airline removed baggage fees completely.
Customers have responded well to the airline's simpler pricing.
Pricing structure never affects how satisfied customers feel.
quests.correctAnswer: Customers have responded well to the airline's simpler pricing.
quests.hint: Compare customer satisfaction before and after the airline changed its baggage pricing.
quests.explanation: Satisfaction ratings rose for three quarters in a row after the airline simplified its baggage fees, suggesting travelers responded well to the change.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The city's outdoor concert series used to take place only in July, drawing modest crowds. After organizers expanded it to run from May through September, total attendance for the season more than tripled.
options: A longer concert season brought in far more visitors overall.
Attendance for the concert series decreased after it was extended.
The concert series was shortened to just one month.
The length of a concert series never affects attendance.
quests.correctAnswer: A longer concert season brought in far more visitors overall.
quests.hint: Compare total attendance before and after the series was extended.
quests.explanation: Attendance more than tripled once the concert series ran for five months instead of one, showing the longer schedule brought in far more visitors overall.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Before the apartment building installed a package room with individual lockers, deliveries were often left in the lobby and occasionally went missing. Residents say almost no packages have gone missing since the lockers were installed six months ago.
options: More packages have gone missing since the lockers were installed.
The lockers appear to have made deliveries more secure for residents.
The building removed the package lockers after complaints.
Where packages are left never affects their safety.
quests.correctAnswer: The lockers appear to have made deliveries more secure for residents.
quests.hint: Compare how often packages went missing before and after the lockers were added.
quests.explanation: Missing packages became rare after individual lockers replaced the open lobby drop-off, suggesting the lockers made deliveries safer for residents.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: A ride-sharing app recently added a feature that shows drivers their customer rating before accepting a trip. Since the feature launched, passengers have reported noticeably shorter wait times for pickups in most cities.
options: Wait times have increased since the feature launched.
The app removed the driver rating system entirely.
Seeing ratings in advance seems to be speeding up pickups.
Showing ratings to drivers never affects pickup times.
quests.correctAnswer: Seeing ratings in advance seems to be speeding up pickups.
quests.hint: Think about how seeing a passenger's rating in advance might change a driver's decision to accept a trip.
quests.explanation: Wait times dropped after drivers could see passenger ratings before accepting trips, suggesting the feature is influencing how quickly drivers respond.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Although the district shortened the school day by thirty minutes this year to save on transportation costs, standardized test scores across every grade level rose slightly compared to the previous year's results.
options: Test scores dropped sharply after the school day was shortened.
The district extended the school day instead of shortening it.
A shorter school day did not appear to harm student performance.
The length of the school day always determines test scores.
quests.correctAnswer: A shorter school day did not appear to harm student performance.
quests.hint: Compare what happened to test scores after the school day changed.
quests.explanation: Even though the school day became shorter, test scores actually rose slightly, showing the change did not hurt student performance.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Maria used to pay her credit card bill whenever she remembered, sometimes missing the due date. Since she set up an automatic payment each month, she has not been charged a late fee in over a year.
options: Maria has been charged more late fees since setting up automatic payment.
Automatic payments have kept Maria from missing due dates.
Maria cancelled her credit card after the change.
Automatic payments never affect whether a bill is paid on time.
quests.correctAnswer: Automatic payments have kept Maria from missing due dates.
quests.hint: Compare how often Maria was late before and after setting up automatic payment.
quests.explanation: Maria hasn't paid a late fee in over a year since switching to automatic payments, showing the change solved her problem with missed due dates.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The grocery store used to place candy and snacks near the checkout lines. After moving those items to a separate aisle and placing fruit near the registers instead, weekly fruit sales rose by almost thirty percent.
options: Fruit sales dropped after the store rearranged its checkout area.
The store removed fruit from its shelves entirely.
What customers see at checkout seems to influence what they buy.
Where products are placed in a store never affects sales.
quests.correctAnswer: What customers see at checkout seems to influence what they buy.
quests.hint: Think about what customers see while waiting in the checkout line.
quests.explanation: Fruit sales rose after fruit replaced candy near the checkout, suggesting where an item is placed can influence what customers buy.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The customer service team used to handle all calls without any script, and calls often lasted over ten minutes. After introducing a short call guide for common issues, average call length dropped to under five minutes.
options: Calls became longer after the guide was introduced.
Calls are being resolved much faster since the guide was introduced.
The company stopped taking customer service calls.
Having a call guide never affects how long calls last.
quests.correctAnswer: Calls are being resolved much faster since the guide was introduced.
quests.hint: Compare average call length before and after the guide was introduced.
quests.explanation: Average call length dropped by more than half after the call guide was introduced, suggesting it helped staff resolve issues more quickly.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The office building used to leave hallway lights on twenty-four hours a day. Since installing motion-sensor lighting that turns off automatically when no one is present, the building's monthly electricity costs have dropped by nearly a quarter.
options: The motion-sensor lighting has reduced the building's electricity costs.
Electricity costs increased after the motion sensors were installed.
The building removed the hallway lighting altogether.
The type of lighting system never affects electricity costs.
quests.correctAnswer: The motion-sensor lighting has reduced the building's electricity costs.
quests.hint: Compare the building's electricity costs before and after installing motion sensors.
quests.explanation: Monthly electricity costs fell by almost a quarter after motion-sensor lighting replaced lights that ran constantly, showing the new system is saving energy.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Before switching to a standing desk at work, Wen often complained of lower back pain by the end of nearly every workday. Three months after making the switch, she says the pain has almost completely disappeared.
options: Wen's back pain has eased considerably since she began using a standing desk.
Wen's back pain got worse after switching desks.
Wen returned to her old desk after one week.
The type of desk a person uses never affects back pain.
quests.correctAnswer: Wen's back pain has eased considerably since she began using a standing desk.
quests.hint: Compare Wen's back pain before and after she started using the standing desk.
quests.explanation: Wen's back pain nearly disappeared in the months after she switched to a standing desk, suggesting the new desk helped with her discomfort.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The Alaoui family used to eat dinner in front of the television most nights. Since they started a rule of leaving all screens in another room during meals, their teenage son has begun telling them more about his day.
options: Their son has stopped talking during dinner altogether.
The family gave up the screen-free rule after a week.
Removing screens at dinner seems to have opened up conversation with their son.
Removing screens during meals never affects conversation.
quests.correctAnswer: Removing screens at dinner seems to have opened up conversation with their son.
quests.hint: Think about what changed about mealtime and what the son started doing differently.
quests.explanation: Their son began sharing more once screens were removed from dinner, suggesting the new rule created space for more conversation.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The bookstore used to organize novels only by author's last name, which made it hard for customers to browse by genre. After adding genre-based sections with handwritten staff recommendations, sales of novels by first-time authors have doubled.
options: Sales of novels by new authors fell after the change.
The bookstore removed all fiction sections.
How books are organized never affects which ones customers buy.
New writers' books are getting noticed more since the reorganization.
quests.correctAnswer: New writers' books are getting noticed more since the reorganization.
quests.hint: Think about how browsing by genre, instead of only by author, might help lesser-known writers.
quests.explanation: Sales of first-time authors' novels doubled after the store added genre sections and recommendations, suggesting the new layout helped readers discover new writers.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Every year, Mr. Yamada's neighborhood association collects donated coats for winter. This year, after posting flyers in three additional languages, the number of coats donated was the highest the association has ever recorded.
options: Coat donations were lower this year than in previous years.
The multilingual flyers likely reached donors the old flyers had missed.
The association stopped collecting coats this year.
The language of a flyer never affects how many people respond.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Visitors to the national park used to receive only a paper map, and rangers often repeated the same directions many times a day. Since the park launched a free trail app with GPS directions, far fewer visitors now ask rangers for directions.
options: Visitors ask rangers for directions more often since the app launched.
The trail app has reduced how often rangers must give directions.
The park removed paper maps but did not replace them.
How visitors receive directions never affects how often they ask rangers.
quests.correctAnswer: The trail app has reduced how often rangers must give directions.
quests.hint: Compare how often rangers gave directions before and after the app launched.
quests.explanation: Requests for directions dropped sharply once the GPS trail app became available, suggesting many visitors now rely on the app instead of asking rangers.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The independent film had almost no advertising budget and was expected to earn very little in its first weekend. After several popular reviewers praised it online, ticket sales tripled in its second weekend compared to its first.
options: Ticket sales dropped in the film's second weekend.
The film was pulled from theaters after its first weekend.
Reviews never affect how many tickets a film sells.
Positive online reviews appear to have driven the jump in ticket sales.

quests.hint: Think about what happened right before ticket sales increased.
quests.explanation: Ticket sales tripled only after reviewers began praising the film online, suggesting the positive attention helped attract more viewers in its second weekend.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The town used to hold its farmers market only on Saturday mornings, when many working residents were unable to attend. Since adding a Wednesday evening market as well, vendors report selling noticeably more produce each week overall.

The town removed the Saturday market entirely.
The timing of a market never affects how much vendors sell.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.

The app removed the tutorial due to poor results.
More new users are sticking with the app since the tutorial was added.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Teachers at Lincoln Middle School used to assign textbook homework every night, and many students said they rarely finished it. After switching to shorter, more focused practice assignments, the percentage of students completing homework on time has risen substantially.
options: Homework completion has improved since assignments became shorter and more focused.
Homework completion rates fell after the assignments were shortened.
The school stopped assigning homework altogether.
The length of an assignment never affects whether students complete it.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.

The nonprofit stopped accepting donations by mail.
How an organization contacts donors never affects how much it raises.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.

A broader range of courses has drawn in more students.

quests.explanation: Enrollment grew for two semesters in a row after the school expanded beyond French cuisine, suggesting the wider variety attracted more students.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.

Wait times increased after the fast-track area was added.
The hospital closed its emergency room during evenings.
How an emergency room is organized never affects wait times.

quests.hint: Compare emergency room wait times before and after the fast-track area was created.
